title: Cough and congestion visit
reason: Cough and stuffy nose for three days; breathing comfortably.
findings: Lungs sounded clear; temperature was in the usual range.
home_steps: Rest, drink fluids, and use a humidifier if it feels comfortable.
medicines: No medicine was started at this visit.
follow_up: Contact the clinic if symptoms are not improving within one week.
warnings: Get urgent medical help for trouble breathing, blue lips, severe chest pain, or confusion.

title: Ankle sprain check
reason: Right ankle pain after a gentle twist while walking.
findings: Mild swelling; able to walk; no open wound noted.
home_steps: Rest the ankle, raise it when sitting, and use a wrapped cold pack for short periods.
medicines: No medicine was started at this visit.
follow_up: Arrange a clinic recheck in 7 to 10 days if walking is still difficult.
warnings: Seek urgent care for rapidly worsening pain or swelling, a numb or cold foot, or inability to bear weight.

title: Sore throat visit
reason: Sore throat and mild fever since yesterday.
findings: Throat was mildly red; rapid test was negative.
home_steps: Sip fluids, rest, and choose soft foods while the throat is sore.
medicines: No prescription medicine was started; ask a trusted adult or clinician before using an over-the-counter medicine.
follow_up: Call the clinic if the fever lasts more than three days or symptoms get worse.
warnings: Get urgent help for difficulty breathing or swallowing, drooling, or signs of dehydration.

title: Small skin rash visit
reason: Itchy patch on the arm noticed earlier this week.
findings: Small dry patch; no swelling or spreading redness seen.
home_steps: Keep the area clean and avoid scratching; stop any new product that seems to irritate it.
medicines: No medicine was started at this visit.
follow_up: Contact the clinic if the rash spreads or is not improving in one week.
warnings: Seek urgent help for face or tongue swelling, trouble breathing, or a rapidly spreading rash with fever.

title: Stomach ache visit
reason: Mild stomach discomfort since this morning; able to drink fluids.
findings: Belly was soft during the exam; no urgent finding noted.
home_steps: Take small sips of fluids and rest; return to usual foods as comfortable.
medicines: No medicine was started at this visit.
follow_up: Call the clinic if discomfort is not improving by tomorrow.
warnings: Get urgent medical help for severe or worsening pain, repeated vomiting, blood in vomit or stool, or fainting.

title: Ear pain visit
reason: One day of left ear discomfort after a cold.
findings: Ear was mildly irritated; no drainage was seen.
home_steps: Rest and drink fluids; avoid putting objects or drops in the ear unless a clinician recommends them.
medicines: No medicine was started at this visit.
follow_up: Contact the clinic if pain is not improving in two days or new symptoms appear.
warnings: Seek urgent care for swelling behind the ear, severe dizziness, stiff neck, or sudden hearing changes.

title: Routine wellness check
reason: Routine visit to review general health and daily habits.
findings: No new concern was found during today's checkup.
home_steps: Keep regular sleep and activity routines; bring questions to the next checkup.
medicines: No medicines were discussed at this visit.
follow_up: Schedule the next routine checkup as advised by the clinic.
warnings: Contact a clinician if a new or concerning symptom develops; call emergency services for a suspected emergency.

title: Wrist strain visit
reason: Mild wrist soreness after carrying a heavy bag.
findings: No visible swelling or bruising; wrist movement was comfortable.
home_steps: Avoid activities that worsen soreness and rest the wrist for a short time.
medicines: No medicine was started at this visit.
follow_up: Arrange a clinic review if it is not improving within one week.
warnings: Seek urgent care for severe pain, major swelling, numbness, color change, or inability to move the wrist.
